//: A sightless, noseless horror that uses star-vampire attacks.  Very roughly based on 'real-life' melon heads.
description: This creature would look almost like a small human, except for its proportions.  Its emaciated body sits below a massive, bloated head.  In place of a face is a deep divot, almost like a satellite dish - surrounding it is a thin line of razor sharp, fang-like teeth.  When stopped, it stands eerily still.  When it moves, it takes several small measured steps at a time, rotating slowly to scan its surroundings, as if it were performing a practiced dance.

special_attacks.//: Bite for targets whose blood the star vampire does not want or cannot drink.  Should never target the player unless they can't bleed or have unappetizing blood.
special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s bites your %2$s with its fang-filled maw!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s tries to bite you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to bite <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s tries to bite your %2$s, but can't penetrate your armor.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s tries to bite <npcname>'s %2$s, but can't penetrate their armor.

special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s fastens onto your %2$s and greedily drinks your blood!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s fastens onto <npcname>'s %2$s and greedily drinks their blood!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s tries to fasten onto you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to fasten onto you <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s tries to fasten onto your %2$s, but can't penetrate your armor.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s tries to fasten onto <npcname>'s %2$s, but can't penetrate their armor.

special_attacks.//: Since ferals have no blood vitamin, a separate attack to simulate drinking their blood
special_attacks.hit_dmg_u: %1$s fastens onto your %2$s and greedily drinks your blood!
special_attacks.hit_dmg_npc: %1$s fastens onto <npcname>'s %2$s and greedily drinks their blood!
special_attacks.miss_msg_u: %1$s tries to fasten onto you, but you dodge!
special_attacks.miss_msg_npc: %1$s tries to fasten onto <npcname>, but they dodge!
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_u: %1$s tries to fasten onto your %2$s, but can't penetrate your armor.
special_attacks.no_dmg_msg_npc: %1$s tries to fasten onto <npcname>'s %2$s, but can't penetrate their armor.
